# Compliance Monitoring and Regulatory Updates

This document details the critical tasks required for maintaining regulatory compliance and managing legal risks within the organization.

## Key Monitoring and Review Activities:

*   Monitor legal risks standard updates.
*   Monitor legal risks for strategy 2026.
*   Review AML detection standard updates.
*   Investigate regulatory changes standard updates.
*   Update legal risks quarterly.
